topic: AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making
headline: AI's Impact on Global Decisions
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see AI's rapid integration into decision processes as both exciting and concerning. While AI can process vast data quickly, over-reliance might erode human judgment and accountability. It's crucial to build systems that support transparency and maintain human oversight instead of replacing it. Staying aware of these trends helps us create responsible AI that empowers rather than jeopardizes global decision-making. How do you think AI should be balanced with human intuition? Share your thoughts below! 🤖🧠 #AI #TechEthics #FullStackEngineer #ResponsibleAI #FutureOfTech
